description: MySQL database server storing user credentials and loan information. Connected via SQLAlchemy ORM. Contains User table with columns: id, username, password, name, lastname, email, loan_amount, loan_term_months, monthly_payment. Database credentials: root/app_conf@db:3306 (from SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI configuration).
notes: CRITICAL: Passwords stored in plaintext in database. Database credentials hardcoded in application configuration file. Contains sensitive user financial data. Vulnerable to SQL injection attacks through login and profile endpoints.
